events.title: United Conservative Party Annual General Meeting 2026

location.name: BMO Centre
location.address: 1912 Flores Ladue Parade SE, Calgary, AB

events.description: The party's annual general meeting. The official notice says business starts Friday, November 27 at 5:00 p.m. Alberta time and continues through Saturday, November 28, with optional campaign training on Sunday, November 29. The draft schedule lists board candidate speeches and governance debate and voting on Friday, and board election voting and the financial report on Saturday. To vote, a member needed a valid membership by 11:59 p.m. on November 6, 2026.
events.candidates_note: Board of Directors candidates are posted by the party at ucpagm.ca.

source.name: United Conservative Party, Official Notice: 2026 UCP AGM

events.title: Alberta provincial general election
events.description: Section 38.1 of Alberta's Election Act sets general elections on the third Monday in October of the fourth calendar year after the last one, which makes the next one October 18, 2027. The Act does not stop the Lieutenant Governor from dissolving the Legislature earlier, so an election can still be called before this date. Elections Alberta has said new electoral boundaries could leave it short of time, and the Justice Minister has said the government does not intend to change the date.
events.candidates_note: Elections Alberta publishes registered and nominated candidates once the election is called. Parties are already holding nomination meetings; those appear on this calendar as party events.

events.title: Federal general election (fixed date)
events.description: Under the Canada Elections Act, a general election is held on the third Monday in October of the fourth calendar year after the last one. The last general election was April 28, 2025, so the fixed date is October 15, 2029. The Prime Minister can still ask for an earlier election, which would replace this date.
